rows.note: This is the all-purpose pattern for going into a place, with 入嚟 used toward the speaker and 入去 used away from the speaker.

example.english: You can enter and have a seat.
example.jyutping: nei5 jap6 lei4 zo6 haa5 laa1

rows.note: Use this when putting or placing something inside another thing or space.

example.english: Press this button and the coin will enter the slot.
example.traditional: 撳呢個掣，個硬幣就會放入個窿。
example.jyutping: gam6 ni1 go3 zai3 go3 ngaang6 bai6 zau6 wui5 fong3 jap6 go3 lung1

rows.note: Use this for entering text, numbers, usernames, or other data into a computer or device.

example.jyutping: cing2 syu1 jap6 mat6 maa5 sin1

rows.meaning: enter a field or life stage
rows.note: Use this pattern before a state, life stage, or profession, as in entering adolescence or entering an industry.

example.english: They enter the design industry after graduating from university.
example.traditional: 佢大學畢業後入行做設計。
example.jyutping: keoi5 daai6 hok6 bat1 jip6 hau6 jap6 hong4 zou6 cit3 gai3
